body: From the DM-190 final review (orchestrator, this run): `baseClone` in scratch/DM-189/world.ts:59-66 is not concurrency-safe (checks package.json then clones into a shared %TEMP% folder): parallel test files will race — clone to a temp name and rename, or lock. `heldCorrection` takes the earliest epic under a key; pin behaviour when two epics share a key with different payloads (only after documented duplicate cases).
